'''Walter David Neumann''' (1 January 1946 – 24 September 2024) was a British-American mathematician who worked in [[topology]], [[geometric group theory]], and [[singularity theory]]. He was a professor at [[Barnard College]], [[Columbia University]]. Neumann obtained his Ph.D. under the joint supervision of [[Friedrich Hirzebruch]] and Klaus Jänich at the [[University of Bonn]] in 1969.<ref name="birth">[http://math.columbia.edu/~walterfest/walterfest2011/poster/walterfest_A2.pdf Faces of Geometry, A Conference in Honor of Walter Neumann]</ref>

He was a son of the mathematicians [[Bernhard Neumann]] and [[Hanna Neumann]].<ref name="birth" /> His brother [[Peter M. Neumann]] was also a mathematician.

Walter Neumann was elected a member of the [[European Academy of Sciences]] in 2002.<ref>[https://celebratio.org/Neumann_WD/article/992/ Walter D. Neumann: Curriculum Vitae], Walter D. Neumann, [[Celebratio Mathematica]], 2022</ref>
He was in the Inaugural Class of Fellows of the [[American Mathematical Society]], starting from 2013.<ref>[http://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society]</ref>

Neumann died on 24 September 2024, at the age of 78.<ref>[https://sites.google.com/site/nygrouptheory/in-memoriam In Memoriam], New York Group Theory Seminar. Accessed September 25, 2024 </ref><ref>[https://www.math.columbia.edu/2024/09/25/in-memoriam-walter-d-neumann/ In Memoriam: Walter D. Neumann], Department of Mathematics, [[Columbia University]]. Accessed October 2, 2024 </ref>
